description_en: Disables multiple jobs in a batch
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 batch-disable-jobs --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id-list 99341 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDisableJobs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace that contains the jobs. You can find this ID on the Namespaces page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属命名空间ID，在控制台命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: This parameter is used only by specific third-party services
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group. You can find this ID on the Application Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the jobs are located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the jobs to disable
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID列表，多个任务ID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: job_id_list
